title: Returns Reserve Held Back from Final Rebate Checks (Contract Pricing Agreement)
content:
# Returns reserve held back from a final rebate check — Contract Pricing Agreement

**Clause.** On a final rebate check of a Contract Pricing Agreement, the returns reserve follows the return receipt lines the customer's ship-tos received less than 3 whole months before the handling date and the return credit on them, as recorded on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

- 3 or more lines together with 5000.00 or more of return credit hold back 4 percent of the unpaid rebate balance.
- At least one line together with at least 1000.00 of return credit, without both of the higher thresholds, holds back 2 percent of it.
- Anything less holds back no returns reserve.

The amount is held back from the unpaid rebate balance before the final check's floor at 0.00, its rounding to the cent and its minimum payout test are applied; what is held back stays in the rebate balance.

| Receipt lines in the window | Return credit on them | Returns reserve |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | 5000.00 or more | 4 percent of the unpaid balance |
| 3 or more | at least 1000.00, below 5000.00 | 2 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 1000.00 or more (any amount at or above) | 2 percent |
| 1 or more | below 1000.00 | None |
| 0 | — | None |

Hypothetical example: two receipt lines with 1500.00 of credit against an unpaid balance of 3000.00 hold back 60.00.
